description: The file defines an AuthProvider class that manages authentication state (login, logout, bootstrap) for a Flutter application, utilizing an AuthRepository for data operations and notifying listeners about state changes.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier-based provider for managing authentication state, including login, logout, and bootstrap operations.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with a required AuthRepository instance.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes the user session by fetching the current user; sets bootstrap flag and notifies listeners.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Attempts to authenticate a user with email and password; updates loading state and notifies listeners.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user, clears user data, and notifies listeners.
